Name: New Portrait for NPC Arumi
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
[size=4]This is just a set of custom portraits I made for NassiLove's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44286]Arumi the Actress - NPC[/url] mod. I used Poltergeister & Jazzybee's [url=https://jazzybee.itch.io/sdv-creator-masc]Stardew Valley Character Creator[/url] to make it. [/size]

[size=4]To use this portrait, download and overwrite the original Arumi mod's assets with mine, then in the original mod's config, set her portrait to "custom".[/size]

[size=4]Enjoy! [/size]
